{{Top|leg}}
Modular plating was designed as a light-weight substitute for more cumbersome armor. '''Modular plating Mark II''' became the standard [[droid armor]] because of its high protection versus weight ratio and was used in almost every [[Droid/Legends|droid]] army.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 2 to be able to equip this item.
